title: Caring for Yourself Around Busy Schedules with  Lisa Wiesman, our Special guest. #12
description:
In this episode of Working Moms, we’re joined by Lisa Wiesman, an RN, BSN, LMT, and Integrative Health Practitioner Level One, who specializes in helping moms manage their health while juggling busy family and work lives. Lisa shares her expert insights on how to prioritize self-care, improve your health, and manage chronic issues like weight loss, autoimmune disorders, headaches, and leaky gut. Tune in for actionable tips on making time for health, transforming your diet, and taking control of your wellness amidst the chaos of motherhood and a career. Whether you're dealing with health challenges or just looking for ways to improve your overall well-being, this episode is packed with practical advice to help you feel your best.

👉 Topics Covered:

Prioritizing self-care as a busy mom
How to manage health issues like autoimmune diseases and headaches
Tips for making time for wellness amidst a busy schedule
Diet changes and what we put in our bodies to improve health
How to balance family, work, and your personal health
